about: Hand labels, one labeller. Sample A: findings of v0.1.0 (study/sample.py, seed 20261004, cap 8 per rule x confidence, at most 2 per repo, 248 items). Sample B: high and medium findings after the first fixes (seed 777, cap 3, at most 1 per repo, 82 items; many findings also appear in A). Items not listed are counted as true. 'fp' = wrong for the file as written; 'unclear' = the context needed to decide is not in the file. Numbering = index in the sample json. Sample C: high and medium findings of the v0.4.0 scanner (study/sample.py, seed 20261003, cap 3, at most 1 per repo, 63 items) drawn only from repositories that are in neither A nor B (238 repositories excluded).
